answer: Harbor space is scarce. A new key must lease one numbered berth on a working jetty for three epochs and bond a week's fees. Each day a sounding is taken at a randomly assigned dune marker, with GPS and tide signed by a rotating harbor master the applicant does not pick; a missed sounding, or another key sharing a payer, radio, or arrival clock, fuses the leases and burns both bonds. Only a clean lease yields an onyx token layered with those hashes as voting weight. Fifty aliases need fifty paid berths and unsynchronized soundings; collisions expose the operator before any token is cut.
